info.title: Photography album API
info.description: Same-origin REST API. JSON responses use application/json. Unmatched /api requests return 404 with {"code":"not_found"}.

get.summary: Read the coherent shared camera and lens catalogs
get.description: Returns complete catalogs in saved entry order, including empty catalogs. Failed acquisition returns 500, never partial or successful empty data. Lenses have independent identities and may be selected for multiple compatible bodies.

post.summary: Create an independent camera catalog entry
post.description: The server assigns identity. Code and name are nonempty strings preserved as supplied. Interchangeable optics require an explicitly supported mount and sensor format; fixed optics reject mount and sensorFormat fields. No hardware facts are inferred.

put.summary: Replace camera details while preserving identity
put.description: Checks current catalog and actual saved chapter selections under the same single-backend coordination as selection replacement. Rejects compatibility or kind changes that invalidate saved selections; unused combinations do not constrain edits. Acknowledged writes require only authoritative reads after a failed refresh, never repeated mutations.

204.description: Acknowledged updated camera; no response body

delete.summary: Delete an unused camera without deleting lenses

409.description: Saved chapter selection uses this camera; no mutation

post.summary: Create a shared lens catalog entry
post.description: The server assigns identity. Code and name are nonempty strings preserved as supplied. Mount and coverage are required known facts; no owning camera is supplied.

put.summary: Replace shared lens details while preserving identity
put.description: Checks actual saved selections under the same coordination as chapter gear replacement. Rejects changes that invalidate a saved camera/lens pair; unrelated unused catalog combinations do not constrain edits.

204.description: Acknowledged updated lens; no response body

409.description: Saved chapter selection uses this lens; no mutation

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Lowercase canonical album UUID. Malformed IDs return album_not_found; a canonical missing album or foreign chapter returns chapter_not_found.

parameters.name: chapterId
parameters.description: Lowercase canonical chapter UUID scoped to the album. Malformed, missing or foreign targets return chapter_not_found.

get.summary: Read the complete ordered saved chapter selection

200.description: Current saved selection, including empty gear

put.summary: Atomically replace the complete chapter gear selection
put.description: Validates current catalog entries, distinct cameras and per-body distinct lenses under shared mutation coordination. Fixed cameras require empty lensIds; interchangeable cameras require at least one lens. Matching mounts are required; full-frame bodies require full-frame coverage, while APS-C bodies accept either coverage. The same lens may appear on multiple compatible bodies. Empty cameras clears gear. Rejected replacement retains the complete saved selection. Metadata, source/import lifecycle, description and photo composition remain independent and unchanged.

204.description: Acknowledged complete replacement; no response body. Retry a later failed refresh as reads only.

patch.summary: Change a placement's slot, transform or caption corner
patch.description: Supply exactly one of slotId, transform or captionCorner. An occupied destination swaps placements while preserving transforms and caption corners. Corner changes retain photo identity, caption text and every transform. The current placement identity must exist within the scoped spread. Returns the complete saved spread without a postwrite read or retry. Read after failed acknowledgement before retrying.

200.description: Saved spread; removed photo is available again

patch.summary: Change a cover placement's side or transform
patch.description: Supply either slotId or transform. Movement and swaps retain transforms and spine ownership. Read after uncertain writes before retrying.

200.description: Saved cover; removed photo is available again

parameters.name: spreadId
parameters.description: Current spread UUID owned by the album.

post.summary: Place or replace an interior photo
post.description: Synopsis accepts album photos; chapter openings and photo spreads accept their chapter photos. Validate current ownership and globally unique photo use in the same coordination interval as the atomic write. Place initializes centered, unmirrored zoom 1; replacement releases the old photo. Move within this spread swaps occupied destinations and carries transforms and caption corners. Geometry remains with slots. Requests use current saved state, not an editing lease. An uncertain outcome must be read before repeating a mutation.

200.description: Acknowledged saved composition; a later refresh failure must be retried as reads only

get.summary: Read both saved cover sides and spine ownership

200.description: Back on the left, front on the right

post.summary: Place or replace a photo on either cover side
post.description: Uses album-wide photos and the same atomic placement, transform and recovery guarantees as interior edits. Movement and swaps are confined to the two cover sides and preserve transforms. Title, credits and spine ownership remain unchanged. Cover placements have no caption corner.

get.description: Orders by creation time descending, then ID descending. Values below 1 select the first page; values above the available range select the last page. An empty collection returns page 1 with totalPages 0.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Supply at most once as a 32-bit integer. Malformed, valueless or repeated parameters return 400.

post.description: Requires an unused immutable year and generates Journey of the Shepherds <year> as the initial title. Atomically creates an empty synopsis, the lowest-ID AlbumStart template's slots with empty placements, and both empty cover sides. The server assigns a stable UUID and immutable UTC creation time.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Canonical hyphenated UUID, case-insensitive on album metadata operations. Malformed and unknown IDs share the album_not_found response; returned IDs are lowercase.

200.description: Album title, synopsis, selected authors and immutable metadata

patch.description: Accepts any nonblank title, trimming surrounding whitespace. Changes only the title; year, identity, creation time, synopsis and composition remain unchanged.

delete.summary: Delete an album and its owned composition

put.description: Preserves exact plain-text Unicode, whitespace and line breaks. Empty text clears synopsis. Changes only synopsis and returns complete saved album metadata without rereading or retrying. Authoritative reconciliation uses GET /api/albums/{id}; after acknowledgement retry only a failed read.

put.summary: Replace the album's nonempty author selection
put.description: Requires unique supported authors; accepts any nonempty combination and publishes Cosmin, Mara, Iacob display order. Changes only authors and returns complete saved album metadata without rereading or retrying. Authoritative reconciliation uses GET /api/albums/{id}; after acknowledgement retry only a failed read.

Preserves exact plain-text Unicode, whitespace and line breaks. Empty text clears description. Changes only description within the scoped album/chapter; metadata, source, gear and photo import remain unchanged. Acknowledgement returns no body and causes no retry or postwrite read. Authoritative reconciliation uses GET /api/albums/{id}/chapters; after acknowledgement retry only a failed read.

put.summary: Save or clear photo-owned caption text
put.description: Preserves exact plain-text Unicode, whitespace and line breaks. Empty text clears the caption; chapter inventories publish cleared captions as null. Changes only the photo caption, preserving interior corners, transforms and import state. Acknowledgement returns no body and causes no retry or postwrite read. Authoritative reconciliation uses GET /api/chapters/{chapterId}/photos for the photo's chapter; after acknowledgement retry only a failed read.

get.description: Returns the album opening followed by persisted chapter blocks, with each chapter opening before its photo spreads. Browser reads individual spread resources for geometry and placements. Reading never initiates import.

post.summary: Create a vacation or Home chapter
post.description: Atomically saves metadata, country associations, default opening geometry and supplied chronological order. Home is unique and spans the album year. Vacation names are trimmed, nonblank and cannot be Home. Countries must identify distinct catalog entries. Source folders are unique within an album. The 65-interior-spread limit includes all openings and photo spreads but excludes Cover; creation at 64 adds its opening. Invalid input/conflicts return 400. After commit, schedules asynchronous photo processing without waiting for directory/image work; scheduling failed still returns 201 with the saved identity. Retry through photo Refresh, not repeated creation.

parameters.name: chapterId
parameters.description: Lowercase canonical UUID. Malformed, missing or foreign chapter targets return chapter_not_found.

put.description: The resource's kind selects its details shape: vacation requires name, countries, start, end and sourceFolder; Home requires countries and sourceFolder and retains its year-derived period. Changing a saved chapter's kind is rejected by the chapter program. Atomically updates metadata, country associations and chronological positions while preserving chapter identity, description, templates, spread/slot IDs and geometry. A changed folder atomically clears previous photo/placement references and schedules processing after commit; unchanged folders return not-requested. Scheduling failed still returns 200 with the saved identity and offers photo-import retry. Conflicts/validation failures return 400 without changing persisted state.

schema.description: Submit the complete resource metadata in its current kind; the chapter program validates ownership and preserves type under shared coordination.

404.description: Malformed or missing album, or malformed, missing or foreign chapter

post.summary: Insert a default photo spread after a chapter opening or photo spread
post.description: Inserts the seeded 8-4x2 layout immediately after an owned target in the requested chapter. Openings and other chapter blocks stay in place. The 65-interior-spread limit includes openings and excludes Cover. Invalid or foreign afterSpreadId returns 400 or 404 spread_not_found respectively; an album-opening target returns 400. Each action commits atomically under the single backend instance's chapter-mutation lock.

afterSpreadId.description: Lowercase canonical UUID of a spread in the requested chapter.

put.summary: Replace a chapter's complete spread order
put.description: Retains the opening first and every existing spread exactly once. expectedSpreadIds is the order the browser observed. A concurrent change returns 409 without writing. Comparison and replacement share backend mutation coordination; replacement commits in a database transaction. Failed pre-write acquisition returns service_failure. Uncertain acknowledgement returns write_uncertain; reread before retrying.

409.description: Composition changed since the supplied expected order

500.description: Pre-write acquisition failed, or write acknowledgement is uncertain; uncertain writes require rereading before retrying

put.summary: Apply a same-context template to an opening or photo spread
put.description: Preserves spread identity, chapter, position and owner text. Unknown templates and context mismatches return 400. Occupied spreads require explicit confirmation; unconfirmed requests return 409 and change nothing. Confirmed changes match placements by photo-slot order, keep photo and caption corner, reset transforms, release unmatched photos to the chapter's unplaced pool and allocate new slot IDs. Confirmation and mutation share the chapter-mutation lock and persistence transaction. Clients reload workspace state after success.

templateId.description: Lowercase canonical UUID from the spread's context catalog.

200.description: Saved spread and applied template identities

get.summary: Read one spread's saved geometry and placements

delete.summary: Delete a photo spread and its placements
delete.description: Openings return 400. Occupied spreads return 409 without mutation until explicitly confirmed. Removes placements, retains photos in their chapter as unplaced and renumbers remaining photo spreads. Confirmation and mutation share the chapter-mutation lock and persistence transaction.

get.summary: Read complete photos, authoritative counts and runtime processing feedback
get.description: Existing empty chapters return empty photos and zero counts. Reads do not scan originals or initiate generation. Photos are ordered by camera-local capture time ascending, undated last, then case-insensitive/exact filename and chapter ID. Source/storage paths are not exposed.

put.description: No request body. Reconciles immediate-folder JPEG additions, content-hash edits, removals and changed quality asynchronously. Overlapping requests coalesce. Scheduling is distinct from processing completion; a failed launch/read returns 500. Synopsis/Cover clients invoke this operation for each chapter.

202.description: Scheduled or coalesced with current work

get.summary: Subscribe to chapter inventory and processing invalidations
get.description: Validates album existence before streaming. Register before subscribed (data: {}), then emit inventory-changed (data: {chapterId}) after committed photo or processing changes. Heartbeat comments arrive every 15 seconds. Subscribe before initial/reconnect resource acquisition; the browser composes album metadata, ordered chapters, composition membership, individual spreads and chapter photo inventories, buffering invalidations during catch-up. Slow subscribers use bounded coalescing and never block processing. Opening/reconnecting never initiates import; no image bytes travel over SSE.

200.description: Named Server-Sent Events with JSON data

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Lowercase canonical UUID naming an exclusive managed publication, not a photo lookup.

get.summary: Read a supplied immutable managed-thumbnail URL
get.description: Serves only the managed thumbnail root, without a photo-metadata lookup or generation. Original files are never delivered. Malformed/traversal, missing-file and mismatched-version requests return 404.

200.description: One JPEG within its selected preset; globally at most 2048px longest edge and 300,000 bytes

404.description: Managed thumbnail not found; no regeneration

head.summary: Read managed-thumbnail headers without a response body

404.description: Malformed URL or managed thumbnail not found

get.summary: List the complete photo-spread template catalog
get.description: Ascending template-ID order; photo slots in template order. Geometry is percentages of the full spread axes. The reference seeds own names, identities and geometry.

get.summary: List the complete chapter-opening template catalog
get.description: Ascending template-ID order; photo slots followed by one owner-text slot. Geometry is percentages of the full spread axes. The reference seeds own names, identities and geometry.

get.summary: List the complete AlbumStart template catalog
get.description: Ascending template-ID order with slots in template order. Seeded geometry retains the legacy catalog's percentages of full spread width and height, without rescaling. Each template has photo slots and one right-hand synopsis text slot; clients supply no template ID when creating albums.

CameraId.name: cameraId
CameraId.description: Lowercase canonical UUID. Malformed and missing IDs return camera_not_found.

LensId.name: lensId
LensId.description: Lowercase canonical UUID. Malformed and missing IDs return lens_not_found.

SpreadId.name: spreadId
SpreadId.description: Lowercase canonical UUID. Stale, missing or foreign spread identities return spread_not_found. Noncanonical spread-action path segments do not match these routes and use the unmatched API 404 response.

ConfirmPlacements.name: confirmPlacements
ConfirmPlacements.description: Explicitly confirm an occupied mutation. Omitted or false returns 409 when occupied, without changing state. Values other than the literal true or false return 400.

PhotoChapterId.name: chapterId
PhotoChapterId.description: Lowercase canonical UUID. Photo inventory/Refresh routes return chapter_not_found for malformed or missing targets. Spread insertion requires a canonical path segment: noncanonical segments use the unmatched API 404 not_found response; a canonical missing or foreign chapter returns chapter_not_found.

WorkspaceAlbumId.name: id
WorkspaceAlbumId.description: Lowercase canonical UUID. Album metadata, chapter collection and composition reads return album_not_found for malformed or missing IDs. Spread mutation routes require a canonical path segment: noncanonical segments use the unmatched API 404 not_found response; a canonical missing album returns album_not_found.

ContentText.description: Required plain-text string, including empty text. Missing, null or non-string text and malformed JSON return validation feedback.

Title.description: A string title, trimmed before nonblank validation. Malformed JSON, missing or non-string titles, and blank trimmed titles return validation feedback.

ContentMutationFailure.description: service_failure reports a failed operation. mutation_uncertain means acknowledgement was lost and the write may have committed. Reconcile through the authoritative resource read before deciding whether to retry; failed acquisition remains an error rather than empty success.

ContentChapterNotFound.description: Malformed or missing album, or malformed, missing or foreign chapter.

CameraNotFound.description: Malformed camera UUID or camera not found

CatalogConflict.description: Catalog identity or EXIF code is already used; no mutation

CatalogEditConflict.description: Code conflict or proposed optics invalidate an actual saved selection; no mutation

GearMutationFailure.description: service_failure reports an unsuccessful operation. mutation_uncertain means commit acknowledgement was lost: the operation may have committed. Read the authoritative catalog or scoped chapter gear before deciding whether to retry; never treat uncertainty as rejection or empty success.

GearTargetNotFound.description: Malformed album UUID, or malformed, missing or foreign chapter. Reload authoritative state.

LensNotFound.description: Malformed lens UUID or lens not found

PlacementNotFound.description: Current target is missing or belongs elsewhere. Reload authoritative composition. Noncanonical path IDs fall through to the API's not_found response.

PlacementRejected.description: Current ownership or identity validation rejected the edit without partial writes. Reload authoritative state before choosing another action.

SpreadTargetNotFound.description: Album not found, or stale, missing or foreign spread target

AddSpreadTargetNotFound.description: Album or requested chapter not found, or stale, missing or foreign spread target

SpreadOccupied.description: No mutation; repeat the action with confirmPlacements=true only after explicit confirmation

SpreadTemplates.description: Complete context-scoped catalog in ascending template-ID order

ChapterIdentity.description: Persisted chapter identity and independent postcommit scheduling result; failed scheduling preserves the save

ChapterNotFound.description: Malformed chapter ID or chapter not found

ThumbnailNotModified.description: Matching content version; no response body

AlbumSummary.description: Album identity, required immutable year, title and immutable creation time

AlbumNotFound.description: Malformed album ID or album not found

ServiceFailure.description: Infrastructure failure or incomplete persisted composition

CameraDetails.description: Code/name retain whitespace and Unicode as supplied. Identity is server-assigned on create and route-owned on update.

ChapterGear.description: Camera rows and lens IDs retain supplied order. Camera IDs are distinct; lens IDs are distinct per camera but may be shared across rows. All IDs are lowercase canonical UUIDs. lensIds is required: empty encodes fixed use, nonempty encodes interchangeable use; current catalog kind and compatibility are application-validated.

LensDetails.description: Shared independent entry. Code/name retain whitespace and Unicode as supplied; no camera owner.

PhotoTransform.description: Finite pan in InDesign points and zoom relative to centered scale-to-fill. Displayed pan is bounded to keep the destination slot covered; stored transforms survive movement to different geometry. Horizontal mirroring preserves the crop.

PlacementCreation.description: All IDs are lowercase canonical UUIDs. The target slot and eligible photo must exist; the backend allocates the placement identity.

CountryIds.description: Distinct lowercase canonical UUIDs identifying records in the selectable country catalog.

SourceFolder.description: Full backend-visible absolute path, unique within its album and preserved as supplied. Requires nonempty path segments; rejects the bare root, trailing or repeated separators, backslashes, NUL and dot or parent-traversal segments. It need not exist yet.

name.description: Trimmed nonblank destination name, other than Home.

start.description: Inclusive first calendar day; trips may be outside the album year.

end.description: Inclusive last calendar day, not before start; same-day trips are valid.

chapter.description: Null only for the album opening.

placedPhotoIds.description: Authoritative used identities among this chapter's complete canonical photos, including use elsewhere in the album or on Cover. Filter selection by these IDs; retain canonical metadata for rendering. total minus this length equals unplaced.

photos.description: Complete photos with unique identities in chronological order.

counts.description: total equals photos.length; unplaced is derived from authoritative placements and never exceeds total.

capturedLocal.description: Camera-local EXIF date/time, without timezone. Missing/invalid dates are null; never filesystem time.

url.description: Supplied versioned application URL. Use unchanged for lazy loading/cache reuse; never add cache-busting parameters.

PhotoProcessing.description: Transient chapter-local feedback resets to idle on restart, independently of saved photos. completed may include unsupported/undecodable/unstable skips; directory/read/encoding/storage/database/cleanup/scheduling failures are explicit.

filename.description: Immediate source filename, or null for a chapter-wide issue. Codes never expose internal paths or exception details.

name.description: Destination name; Home for a Home chapter.

start.description: Inclusive first day; January 1 of the album year for Home.

end.description: Inclusive last day; December 31 of the album year for Home.

description.description: Persisted chapter owner text, including the empty string.

AlbumAuthors.description: Nonempty author selection, published in Cosmin, Mara, Iacob order.
